name: nimiapp-parentos
description: AI-driven child growth operating system for ParentOS desktop.
author: Nimi Platform

scripts.build:electron: pnpm run build:electron:host && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-electron-main.mjs && node scripts/bundle-electron-preload.mjs
scripts.build:electron:package: node scripts/clean-electron-production.mjs && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:renderer && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin parentos_host && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-electron-preload.mjs && node scripts/package-electron.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:renderer && pnpm run typecheck:electron
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:renderer && (cd src-tauri && cargo check)
scripts.lint: pnpm run check:i18n && pnpm run typecheck && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && (cd src-tauri && cargo check)
scripts.check:i18n: pnpm run i18n:check && pnpm run i18n:audit
scripts.check:spec-consistency: pnpm run spec:authority:check && pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-parentos-spec-consistency.ts
scripts.check:phase1-closeout: pnpm run generate:knowledge-base && pnpm run generate:who-lms-assets && pnpm run check:spec-consistency && pnpm run check:knowledge-base && pnpm run check:nurture-mode-safety && pnpm run check:ai-boundary && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:phase2-closeout: pnpm run generate:knowledge-base && pnpm run generate:who-lms-assets && pnpm run check:spec-consistency && pnpm run check:knowledge-base && pnpm run check:nurture-mode-safety && pnpm run check:ai-boundary && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:contracts: node --import tsx --test test/electron-host-contract.test.mjs test/electron-command-policy.test.mjs test/raw-path-shell-contract.test.mjs test/sidecar-command-parity.test.mjs test/acceptance-script-contract.test.mjs test/demographic-matrix.test.mjs
scripts.test: vitest run && pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:sidecar-protocol
